news.title: datasette-llm 0.1a11
news.dek:
Release:   datasette-llm 0.1a11 
 datasette-llm  is the intermediate plugin for Datasette that supports configuring LLMs for use with other Datasette plugins. 
 This release adds support for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so you can configure Datasette to use an LLM hosted anywhere
news.aiSummary: The datasette-llm plugin, which allows Datasette to configure LLMs for other plugins, has released version 0.1a11. This update introduces support for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, enabling users to connect Datasette to LLMs hosted on various platforms.
